title: Pure-generator calculation for the fixed-degree quotient/pullback component
statement: After transposing through the finite quotient and inverse-image adjunctions, the two fixed-degree comparison maps agree on each pure tensor generator.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 06YY and 07A4, ordinary pure-tensor generator calculation.

proof.text: Evaluate both transposed composites on a pure tensor in one bidegree. Naturality of the inverse-image and finite quotient units, hc, hcc, and the four supplied generator normalizations identify the values.
